ownership.quote: The Open-Source Alternative to Claude Managed Agents. Founded in 2025 by Kartik Sarangmath and Ishaan Sehgal, Omnara has 4 employees based in San Francisco.

stage.quote: Omnara has raised $500,000 in total funding, primarily backed by Y Combinator (YC S25) and Pioneer Fund. Round Type: Seed / Accelerator (Y Combinator standard batch funding)
stage.note: Only funding identified is the $500K YC standard batch investment plus Pioneer Fund; aggregators (Crunchbase/PitchBook via Google AI Overview, and a separate 'Fundraise Insider' California startup list dated 2026-07-23) label this variously as pre-seed or seed/accelerator. No priced seed round beyond the YC deal was found, so treated as pre-seed. No company/investor press release confirms amount or date directly.

total_funding_usd.basis: Crunchbase/PitchBook aggregate figures surfaced via Google AI Overview; matches YC's standard ~$500K batch investment size
total_funding_usd.quote: Omnara has raised $500,000 in total funding, primarily backed by Y Combinator (YC S25) and Pioneer Fund.

last_round.quote: Die Runde über 500K USD wurde im Spätsommer 2025 abgeschlossen. Neben Y Combinator und dem Pioneer Fund beteiligten sich im Rahmen erweiterter Konsortien auch namhafte Co-Investoren wie Conversion Capital.

note: Omnara (YC S25, founders Ishaan Sehgal and Kartik Sarangmath) is a small, early-stage (4-employee) open-source agent control-plane startup. Its own website (omnara.com) matches the YC directory entry's domain and description ('Backed by Combinator' banner on homepage), confirming the same company. Funding data beyond the ~$500K YC/Pioneer Fund round is thin and not independently confirmed by press or company statements; treat funding/stage numbers as aggregator estimates, not confirmed figures.
